observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment capability-intelligence and owner-pass trace projections

request.existing_relationship: Scoped capability invocations were correlated with owner passes by exact service execution identity.
request.missing_relationship: The correlated projection omitted the process-resource sample already carried by a newer owner trace.
request.response_budget_pressure: At an 8 KB ECI response limit, duplicate service-accountability caveats caused the exact owner activity group to be removed before it could expose a cost summary.

outcome.interpretation: A resource sample beside a trace row is not useful to another agent unless the existing invocation-to-execution relationship carries it into the inspectable ECI view. Compact response prioritization also needs to preserve that exact relationship under its documented byte limit.
outcome.scope: Source review and deterministic projection behavior; the observation does not establish a live owner cost or an environmental service failure.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Correlated ambient service activity does not expose owner resource costs
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment capability intelligence and ambient owner traces
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The ECI projection linked capability events to exact owner execution IDs and outcomes, while the newer owner trace carried a bounded process-resource sample that was not exposed beside those correlated events. An 8 KB response test also showed the exact activity group could be dropped under duplicate context overhead.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Join validated resource samples to their exact trace-correlated owner activity, compact counters without process identity, and keep the evidence visible within the existing ECI response budget.

measurement_limits: No fresh live owner execution has yet produced a resource sample correlated to agent-facing service activity.
Scheduler-process counters exclude children and do not show that a service caused all measured activity.
No service fulfillment, agent receipt, intervention-burden reduction, or cost improvement is established.
